Requirement: Implement hybrid gamma–phi high-pressure VLE; preserve the project-specific model.
Acceptance Criterion: Model formulation matches assignment and high-pressure standard state is documented.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Target gamma-phi residual exceeds 1e-6; model not accepted.

Requirement: Calculate liquid activity coefficients with NRTL.
Acceptance Criterion: Compare with source example; verify pure-component limits and finite positive gamma.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Source code exists, but parameter validity and MATLAB runtime test remain open.

Requirement: Calculate vapour fugacity coefficients using SRK EOS.
Acceptance Criterion: Cubic residual, root admissibility and fugacity comparison pass.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Source inspection only; MATLAB runtime not executed and kij not validated.

Requirement: Document the complete liquid/vapour fugacity equality and high-pressure reference-state corrections.
Original Source: Assignment starting equation p.2; Phase 1 brief §4.3
Acceptance Criterion: Each component log-fugacity residual is within justified tolerance; correction study is documented.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Component log-fugacity residuals fail specified criterion.

Requirement: Choose a benchmark mixture only because project-specific mixture data are missing; source its validation data.
Acceptance Criterion: System and selection rationale are documented; reference points are traceable.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Selected benchmark and 99 published reference points are documented; independent transcription check still recommended.

Requirement: Define all process inputs with value, units, source/range and status as reported/calculated/assumed/regressed.
Acceptance Criterion: No unknown is disguised as a populated measured value; ranges and conventions are recorded.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Candidate liquid volumes and high-pressure model parameters remain low-confidence or unaccepted.

Requirement: Use one internally consistent SI unit system and explicit boundary conversions.
Acceptance Criterion: Unit round-trip tests pass and output units are labelled.
Audit Finding / Limitation: SI conventions documented; MATLAB unit round-trip tests not run.

Requirement: Validate input values, physical bounds, component count and normalisation.
Acceptance Criterion: Invalid values are rejected with actionable messages; valid compositions normalise within tolerance.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Validation source exists, but runtime tests not run.

Requirement: Solve the equilibrium/process equations by a documented numerical method.
Acceptance Criterion: Test states converge and independent residual checks pass.
Audit Finding / Limitation: No accepted predictive equilibrium solution at benchmark conditions.

Requirement: Record convergence tolerances, initialization, stop conditions, failure codes, conditioning and restart policy.
Acceptance Criterion: Failure and limiting cases return structured messages and diagnostic values.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Solver diagnostics exist, but runtime failures and tolerances untested in MATLAB.

Requirement: Distinguish physically valid single-phase outcomes from solver failure.
Acceptance Criterion: Single-phase status is returned only when supported by thermodynamic feasibility checks.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Phase stability and robust single-phase classification incomplete.

Requirement: Close total and component material balances; report absolute and relative errors.
Acceptance Criterion: Every component balance and total closure pass the stated criterion.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Reference interpolation flows close by algebra; not a predictive flash balance.

Requirement: Close energy balance where applicable and identify specified heat/work terms.
Acceptance Criterion: Energy residual and sign convention are documented and independently checked.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Enthalpy method incomplete; scenario duty is not an accepted energy closure.

Requirement: Translate flow and phase loads into preliminary equipment design with sourced sizing methods.
Acceptance Criterion: Dimensions and design margin follow cited correlation; pressure/flow feasibility is reported.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Hydraulic screening completed; detailed separator internals and mechanical design are not.

Requirement: Calculate duty and convert to relevant utilities using specified conditions and efficiencies.
Acceptance Criterion: Utility consumption reproduces from sourced enthalpy/condition inputs.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Utility values are scenario-only, based on assumed duty and utility enthalpy drop.

Requirement: Produce transparent preliminary CAPEX with documented correlations, cost index and basis.
Acceptance Criterion: Cost basis, currency, source year, index pair, factors and uncertainty are stated.
Audit Finding / Limitation: CAPEX blocked pending credible pressure/material cost correlation and cost basis.

Requirement: Estimate OPEX from calculated utilities and supported operating quantities.
Acceptance Criterion: OPEX traces to each physical consumption and dated source price.
Audit Finding / Limitation: OPEX scenario only; no accepted process consumption or dated site tariff.

Requirement: Perform at least five independent sensitivity studies on influential variables.
Acceptance Criterion: Each study varies one input independently and reports feasibility/convergence plus outputs.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Five families are recorded, but not five validated target-model predictive studies.

Requirement: Prepare a top-level flowchart of the full simulation workflow.
Acceptance Criterion: Flow covers inputs, properties, solve, balances, design, utilities, economics, sensitivity and outputs.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Top-level flowchart included and reviewed.

Requirement: Prepare detailed nonlinear solver flowchart covering initialization, convergence, stop and failure logic.
Acceptance Criterion: Diagram includes invalid properties, retry budget, physical checks and accepted/failure paths.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Detailed solver flowchart included; runtime implementation remains untested.

Requirement: Separate inputs/data, thermodynamics, solver, balances, design, economics, plotting and GUI logic.
Acceptance Criterion: Modules callable without GUI and have consistent inputs/outputs.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Modular source structure exists; callable-engine integration tests not run.

Requirement: Build GUI for major conditions/model selection, Run/Calculate, Reset and clear errors.
Acceptance Criterion: Manual test covers inputs, run, reset, errors and results.
Audit Finding / Limitation: GUI source exists; interactive controls have not been tested.

Requirement: Display numerical results in tables/plots and allow export.
Acceptance Criterion: Exported numeric data and figures match the displayed state.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Export and plotting source exists; generated output matching GUI state is untested.

Requirement: Verify limiting cases and simple analytical cases where available.
Acceptance Criterion: Tests pass with reproducible logs; deviations are explained.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Tests were authored, but MATLAB runtime unavailable.

Requirement: Compare at least one calculated case against an open-literature/textbook/trusted dataset.
Acceptance Criterion: At least one measured/reference point set and deviations are reported.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Published alternative model comparison is contextual; target model is not validated against the measured dataset.

Requirement: Report absolute and relative deviations and document discrepancies/data causes.
Acceptance Criterion: Metrics include point count, units, source rows, training/holdout flag and exclusions.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Absolute/relative differences and model limitations are reported where data support them.

Requirement: Explain what results mean for operations/design, including trends, limits, data quality and limitations.
Acceptance Criterion: Every key result has physical interpretation and limitations; numerical output is not presented alone.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Engineering interpretation of measured split, failure, equipment and energy/cost limitations is included.

Requirement: Retain all technical report topics numbered 8–21 in the supplied order.
Acceptance Criterion: All 14 topics exist in the required order; numbering discrepancy is recorded.
Audit Finding / Limitation: All assignment section topics 8–21 are present in order.

Requirement: Provide an executable MATLAB entry point, README, instructions, input format and expected outputs.
Acceptance Criterion: A clean-user run works from documented commands and identifies required dependencies.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Entry points and instructions exist; clean MATLAB execution is not run.

Requirement: Document migration path to NumPy/SciPy/pandas/matplotlib or suitable open-source tools.
Acceptance Criterion: Core residuals/data records have clear Python equivalents with dependency versions.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Python/open-source migration notes included; no full Python port claimed.

Requirement: Include MATLAB source, main script/GUI, source-backed data, report, plots, validation, README and presentation.
Acceptance Criterion: Every required item is present, opens correctly and is internally consistent.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Artifacts assembled; final acceptance dependent on MATLAB runtime and model remediation.

Requirement: Do not hard-code outputs to reproduce reference tables.
Acceptance Criterion: Changing input changes computed outputs through model equations; no result lookup masquerades as a solve.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Separate reference fixture exists; invariant-input tests and model-coupling checks unexecuted.

Requirement: Benchmark an appropriate alternative property formulation.
Acceptance Criterion: Alternative has sourced equations/parameters and is compared on same experimental points.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Literature PRSV results reviewed but alternative EOS not implemented locally for like-for-like calculations.

Requirement: Keep parameter-training evidence distinct from validation evidence wherever feasible.
Acceptance Criterion: No held-out point is used for tuning without being relabelled as training.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Training vs 2 MPa holdout evidence is explicitly distinguished; trial fit rejected.

Requirement: Preserve scientific symbols and units clearly in technical report and documentation.
Acceptance Criterion: Every reported engineering variable has consistent symbol, meaning and units.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Symbols and units are used consistently and defined.

Requirement: Keep a reproducible default case and structured run data including diagnostics.
Acceptance Criterion: Run can be repeated from saved inputs and emits matching results within declared tolerances.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Default input fixture exists, but reproducible MATLAB rerun is not executed.

Requirement: Maintain a design basis and assumptions/uncertainty register with status and consequence.
Acceptance Criterion: Every critical unresolved point has owner/phase, action and impact.
Audit Finding / Limitation: Data provenance, assumptions and outstanding decisions are recorded.

Requirement: Keep the GUI separate from the calculation engine and support export of results and figures.
Acceptance Criterion: The same solver can be run in command-line tests without launching GUI.
Audit Finding / Limitation: GUI and engine are in separate folders; integration/export tests remain unexecuted.
